meta: What to cook today? Ask AI for dishes from what's in your fridge, when it's full but you only know a few old recipes.

muc.title: A full fridge, no ideas
muc.text: The fridge is full and you still don't know what to cook, because you only know a few old dishes.

muc.title: Name everything you have
muc.text: Photograph the fridge or type a list of what's left, spices included, and send it to a chatbot, an AI chat assistant.

muc.title: Three dishes, little shopping
muc.text: Ask for three dishes using only what you have, noting what you'd need to buy and how long each takes.

muc.title: Spoiled food goes out
muc.text: AI can't smell food. Anything that smells odd, has changed color or is past its date goes in the trash, no regrets.

muc.title: Five things for dinner
muc.text: Open the fridge, list five things left and ask AI for a dinner idea for tonight.

thu: Open the fridge, list 5 things left and ask AI for a dinner idea for tonight.
